description:
GLOBAL BEAUTY CARE

Affiliate Partner FAQ

Everything a creator or affiliate needs to know before promoting Global Beauty Care

About Our Brand and Products

Global Beauty Care was founded in 2011 as a family-owned beauty company. Since then it has grown into a multi-brand portfolio that also includes Spascriptions and The Spathecary, all built around the same idea: prestige-inspired formulas, trending ingredients, and premium-feeling delivery systems, priced for everyday shoppers rather than department-store budgets.

The catalog spans the full skincare routine: cleansers and face washes, exfoliating scrubs, treatment serums (Vitamin C, hyaluronic acid, collagen, AHA), eye creams and eye serums, sheet and spa treatment masks, peel-off and hydrogel masks, cleansing wipes, and nose strips. Popular collections include the Power Skincare Collection, Smooth & Lift Collection, Glowing Vitamin C Collection, Blemish Control Collection, and Youthful Skincare Collection.

Individual items typically run $9.99–$13.99, and 4-piece collection sets are $16.99 on globalbeautycare.com, with free shipping on every order and 20% off (code MORESKINCARE) when a customer orders 3 or more items. The products are also sold on Amazon, and select sets and singles are famously available at Dollar Tree and Walmart — which is a big part of the brand's story (more on that below).

What Makes Us Different

Most affordable skincare feels like a compromise. Global Beauty Care's whole positioning is proving that a shopper doesn't have to choose between a formula that performs and a price that's actually accessible — the brand describes its mission as bringing "prestige-inspired formulas with trending ingredients" to a broad audience without the prestige price tag.

  • Clean, cruelty-free standards: products are cruelty-free, contain no animal by-products, and use plant-derived (palm fruit) glycerin instead of animal-sourced glycerin.
  • Gives back: the brand partners with Feeding America to support hunger relief — giving customers a reason to feel good about a purchase.
  • Everywhere, at an impulse price point: because sets are sold at Dollar Tree and Walmart as well as online, shoppers can act on a recommendation the same day, in person, for a few dollars — a much lower barrier than most affiliate offers.
  • Built-in viral appeal: "Dollar Tree skincare dupe" and "is it actually good?" content is already a proven, high-performing format on TikTok and YouTube Shorts, independent of anything the brand pays for. Creators are already reviewing Global Beauty Care products organically — that built-in curiosity and search volume makes it easier for affiliate content to get discovered.

Worth setting expectations honestly with your audience: independent reviewers are generally positive on hydration, texture, and value, and consistently point out this is a budget line, not a clinical or dermatologist-formulated brand — so it lands best as "impressive for the price" rather than a luxury anti-aging claim.

How Affiliates Can Earn

Global Beauty Care does not currently have a public, self-serve affiliate portal listed on its website — so before recruiting outside affiliates, this is the one section Eric/the GBC team will need to finalize internally (commission rate, cookie duration, payout method and schedule, and which platform will run it, e.g. Shopify affiliate app, Amazon Associates for Amazon-listed SKUs, or a network like ShareASale/Impact/Refersion).

For context, comparable mass-market skincare and beauty affiliate programs commonly offer commissions in the 8%–20% range per sale, plus flat bonuses for top performers or exclusive discount codes affiliates can offer their audience (Global Beauty Care already has a working promo mechanism in MORESKINCARE for 20% off 3+ items, which could be adapted into affiliate-specific codes for easy tracking).

Once the program terms are set, this section should spell out plainly: the commission rate, how long the tracking cookie lasts, the minimum payout threshold, how often payouts go out, and whether there are performance tiers or bonuses for high-volume affiliates.

How to Promote Us

The content formats that already work for this category on social platforms are the ones affiliates should lean into, since audiences have shown they respond to them:

  • Haul and try-on reviews: "I tried the $1.25 Dollar Tree serum so you don't have to" style videos consistently perform well — filming an honest first impression or 7-day check-in builds trust fast.
  • "Is it a dupe?" comparisons: side-by-side comparisons against prestige products (e.g., a Vitamin C serum or collagen mask) tap into an already-viral TikTok trend.
  • Routine videos: using a full collection set (like Smooth & Lift or Glowing Vitamin C) in a morning or nighttime routine video shows real usage rather than just packaging.
  • Roundup content: a blog or YouTube "best drugstore/dollar store skincare" roundup that includes Global Beauty Care alongside other budget picks performs well in search and feels credible rather than purely promotional.
  • Drive to purchase: affiliates should link directly to globalbeautycare.com (or the Amazon storefront) and mention the free shipping and MORESKINCARE 20%-off-3+ offer, which gives followers an immediate reason to act.

Because the products are also stocked at Dollar Tree and Walmart, affiliates can just as effectively direct followers to "look for it at Dollar Tree" as to an online link, which is unusual flexibility for an affiliate offer and worth calling out explicitly.

Other Information

  • Where it's sold: globalbeautycare.com, Amazon, Dollar Tree, and Walmart (in-store and online).
  • Partnership inquiries: customers can reach the team through the Contact Us form on globalbeautycare.com; this is also currently the best channel for a prospective affiliate to inquire about partnership terms until a formal program page exists.
  • Brand credibility: family-owned since 2011, cruelty-free, and no animal by-products — worth mentioning for audiences who care about clean-beauty and cruelty-free claims.
  • Best practice: recommend affiliates keep reviews honest and specific (what it's good for, what it isn't) — that authenticity is exactly what's driving organic Global Beauty Care content to perform well already, and it protects long-term trust with their audience.


Note: This document was compiled from Global Beauty Care's public website and independently published reviews/social content (TikTok, YouTube, and blog reviews) as of August 2026, since no internal affiliate documentation was available in this session. Please review and adjust the commission and partnership details in Section 3 before sharing this with prospective affiliates.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Spascriptions! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.


3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: support@spascriptions.com.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to support@spascriptions.com for support.
